authorCommits.message:
fix(i18n): ignore unknown locales in set_locale and force_locale, deprecate set_locale (#4886)

* fix(i18n): ignore unknown locales in set_locale and force_locale

`?set_locale=` writes Avo.configuration.locale for the whole process
without a check. A request with an unknown value (for example
`?set_locale=zz`) stored it, and after that every Avo request from
every user raised I18n::InvalidLocale (500) until the process restarted.

Accept the param only when I18n.locale_available? says yes. An unknown
value is ignored, so the cookie or the configured default applies.
`force_locale` gets the same check, so a bad value no longer gives a 500.

* chore(i18n): deprecate the set_locale param

`?set_locale=` changes the locale for every user until the process
restarts. The locale selector now stores the locale per user, and
`?force_locale=` changes it for one request. Log a warning when the
param is used, so apps can move away from it before Avo 5.

* chore(i18n): don't name the version that removes set_locale

The release that removes `?set_locale=` is not scheduled, so the warning
says a future version instead of Avo 5.
